## About
We're a complete auto repair shop and a Shell service station on Lakeview Haven Dr in Houston. You can fill up on fuel, grab motor oil and car care products, and get your car looked at in the same stop.
Our ASE-certified technicians work on all makes and models, foreign and domestic. We specialize in auto air conditioning and heat service, and we also do brakes, tune-ups, oil changes, front end work, batteries, computer diagnostics and state inspections.
Need tires or a tow? We handle those too, and we're a U-Haul dealership. Give us a call or request service online.

## Services
- Auto A/C and heating: Air conditioning and heat service is our specialty.
- Auto repair: Repairs for all makes and models, foreign and domestic.
- Auto maintenance: Oil changes, brake service, tune-ups, batteries, front end work and computer diagnostics.
- State inspections: Get your state inspection done here.
- Fuel injection cleaning: Fuel injection cleaning as part of keeping your engine running right.
- Tires: New and used tire sales from brands like Goodyear, Yokohama and Dunlop, plus balancing and rotation.
- Towing: Towing is available at reasonable prices.
- U-Haul dealership: We're a U-Haul dealer. Call us for details.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: We're open Saturday from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm and closed on Sunday.

Q: Do you sell used tires?
A: Yes. We sell both new and used tires, including brands like Goodyear, Yokohama and Dunlop.
